evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To bridge this gap, we introduce AgentVidBench, a multi-hop video question answering benchmark focused on evaluating the spatial, temporal, and causal reasoning capabilities of MLLM agents.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Real-world video understanding involves more challenging tasks that require multi-hop multimodal reasoning, and there is a critical absence of video benchmarks equipped to rigorously evaluate these agentic capabilities.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experiments with 12 proprietary and open-source MLLMs show that single-turn performance remains limited on AgentVidBench, while integrating these models into state-of-the-art agentic workflows generally improves performance with respect to both accuracy and trajectory scores.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We further present a simple yet effective agentic strategy that serves as a competitive baseline on AgentVidBench, establishing our benchmark as a holistic testbed for future research on agentic video understanding.
